parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1: Use the correct expansion for $\cos(2\theta+\theta)$. DM1: Use correct double-angle formulae to express $\cos3\theta$ in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$. A1 AG: Show sufficient working to confirm $\cos3\theta\equiv4\cos^3\theta-3\cos\theta$.
Total: [3]

steps.working: Use correct double-angle formulae to express $\cos3\theta$ in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$

criteria.working: Use correct double-angle formulae to express $\cos3\theta$ in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$
criteria.observable: Use correct double-angle formulae to express $\cos3\theta$ in terms of $\cos\theta$ and $\sin\theta$

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
*M1: Use the identity and a correct double-angle formula to obtain an equation in $\cos\theta$ using all three terms, for example $6\cos^3\theta-\cos^2\theta-4\cos\theta=0$ or $6\cos^2\theta-\cos\theta-4=0$ after factoring. B1: Obtain $\theta=90^\circ$; allow if $\cos\theta$ was correctly obtained as a factor even with an error in the quadratic factor. DM1: Solve a three-term quadratic in $\cos\theta$ to obtain a value of $\theta$. A1: Obtain one value, for example $25.3^\circ$. A1: Obtain the second value $137.5^\circ$ and no extras in range. Accept angles accurate to $0.1^\circ$; ignore values outside the range. Radian solutions $0.442,1.57,2.40$ are treated as a misread.
Total: [5]
